name: Black 4
description: Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Black 4 was a TIE/ln starfighter within the Imperial Navy. Armed with a pair of L-s1 laser cannons, The TIE/LN starfighter served in the Galactic Empire's Black Squadron by 0 BBY. By that year, it was operated by the TIE pilot DS-61-4 and stationed on the Imperial DS-1 Orbital Battle Station. Black 4's cockpit featured the standard wheel and yoke control system for TIE pilots.
